description: READ-SCHEMA, the held QueryDef part the first card never exercised (its changing process had an unrefreshed QueryDefs collection). Process b creates a saved query QT over U and holds the QueryDef and its Parameters; process a (after a pause and Idle, QueryDefs refreshed, Errors before/after) sets QT's SQL to a different WHERE; b (after 7 s and Idle) reads the held QueryDef's SQL, a fresh Item() from a refreshed collection, and opens a recordset through the held QueryDef; a then deletes QT and creates a new QT with other SQL; b (after a pause) reads the held QueryDef again (expect 3420), a fresh Item and an OpenRecordset. Asks what a held QueryDef shows after another process changes, then replaces its saved definition.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cat-txn-lock probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
